summary: 2026-27 home kit. The club site lists Olimpbet (official partner; its logo is also on the goaltender mask in September 2026 home fixtures) and Laggar (supplier) as club partners, plus the Khabarovsk Krai government coat of arms without a role label. Match photos show no club sponsor on the shirt chest, sleeves or back — only KHL league marks (Mir chest patch, Sogaz on helmets); the goaltender's blocker and pants could not be fully checked.
